answer: A comet passes once and is gone; a relic endures because many hands guarded it. Make identity work the same way: a new agent joins only when three established agents vouch for it, each locking a refundable bond in a cipher-sealed escrow. If the newcomer is later proven a Sybil duplicate, the vouchers' bonds are slashed and the identity is burned, so creating a hundred fakes costs a hundred honest backers.
